headline: the fixed-B L0 crossbar identity fits CAL-A3's split-record fit sizes {2,4,8} GiB to a worst case of +/-4.74% at B_fit = 827.1827 B/ns (exact minimax; binding sizes 2 GiB and 8 GiB); the 5% tolerance-shape window is [825.10, 829.49] B/ns (width 4.39); NO group-G1 provenance point (448 / 720 / 900) lies inside it; the held-out sizes {16,32} GiB miss by +7.63% / +9.64% at B_fit and the miss grows with size — the known-omission finding (size-dependent software-effective bandwidth), reported, never tuned

held_out.scope: the S2 fit objective and every swept value here touch only CAL-A3's split-record fit sizes {2,4,8} GiB; CAL-A1/A2/A7/A12 enter as declared-scale provenance of the swept values (ceilings/derating bridge, never measured values); the {16,32} GiB rows appear ONLY in held_out_evaluation (their run records declare held_out: true)

held_out_evaluation.finding: held-out deviations at the fitted B grow monotonically with size (+7.63% at 16 GiB, +9.64% at 32 GiB) and exceed the 5% tolerance-shape band: the anchor's implied effective B keeps ramping above the fitted window out-of-fit (890.3 / 906.9 B/ns at the held-out sizes vs 788.0..866.4 across the fit sizes) — the fixed-B, zero-overhead L0 identity cannot express a size-dependent software-effective bandwidth BY CONSTRUCTION. THE MISS IS THE FINDING (known-omission candidate); nothing was tuned toward these sizes — B_fit was fixed by the {2,4,8} GiB points alone before the held-out rows were evaluated
held_out_evaluation.historical_context: the E1 untuned sweep's five-point fixed-B minimax misfit was +/-7.02% (docs/calibration/ADJUDICATION.md headline read, 2026-10-29); the S2 three-point fit sits at +/-4.73% in-fit while the held-out rows land at +7.6%/+9.6% — the clean fit/holdout separation isolates the size-dependent ramp as the dominant residual
